IsAlwaysOnTop.description: Whether the main window is currently set to always stay on top

AxisType.description: Axis label (X, Y, Z, A, B, C, U, V, W)

OverallTurnsRatio.description: Turn ratio - distance per revolution (inches/mm per rev for linear, degrees for rotary)

FastJogPlusDirection.description: Fast jog rate in plus direction

FastJogMinusDirection.description: Fast jog rate in minus direction

HomingFeedrate.description: Homing feedrate - the feedrate that the machine will run at to home each axis

MasterAxis.description: Master axis for pairing (0 = none, 1-8 = master axis number)

IsRotary.description: Whether this is a rotary axis (Parameter bit 0)

RotaryWrapAround.description: Rotary DRO wrap around display mode (Parameter bit 1)

PreventDivideBy360.description: Prevent divide by 360 for C-Axis (Parameter bit 7)

HideFromDRO.description: Hide axis from DRO display - ATC Turret (Parameter bit 9)

ParallelToX.description: Rotary axis parallel to X (Parameter bit 11)

ParallelToY.description: Rotary axis parallel to Y (Parameter bit 12)

StepSignalInverted.description: Invert step signal for this axis (Parameter 961 - 4-bit nibble per axis)

DirectionSignalInverted.description: Invert direction signal for this axis (Parameter 961 - 4-bit nibble per axis)

EnableSignalInverted.description: Invert enable signal for this axis (Parameter 961 - 4-bit nibble per axis)

PositiveLimitInput.description: Input number for the positive limit switch (1-based, 1-96, or 0 for none)

NegativeLimitInput.description: Input number for the negative limit switch (1-based, 1-96, or 0 for none)

HomingDirectionPositive.description: Homing direction: true = homes in positive direction, false = homes in negative direction, null = does not home

HasExtensionBoard.description: Whether an extension board is installed

MaxInputs.description: Maximum number of available input ports

BoardConfiguration.description: Board configuration information including type and I/O capabilities

ReadAt.description: Timestamp when the states were read

BulkIOStatesResponse.description: Response containing bulk I/O states for inputs and outputs

Message.description: Message describing the CNC readiness state

CNCReadyResponse.description: Response model for CNC readiness check

Success.description: Whether the reset operation was successful

IsRunning.description: Whether the CNC server is currently running

CanStart.description: Whether the server can be started

CanStop.description: Whether the server can be stopped

Data.description: Array of data items to save in the checkpoint

PlcLines.description: PLC source code as array of lines

MessageLines.description: PLC message file content as array of lines

EstopInputNumber.description: E-stop input number (optional - if provided, will set parameter 0)

PlcLines.description: PLC source code as array of lines

Maximum number of steps that can be pulsed per second

Axis Motor Drive fault delay time (milliseconds)
Global drive fault delay for all axes

Default: 0.1 degrees for X1 mode
